Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The agency must bring the personnel for facility management at its own cost and risk, and the buyer shall have no responsibility for this. The agency shall be responsible for ensuring that they are prese nt regularly on the working days and during the working hours of the respective buyer’s consignee. Ir regular daily-wage employees must be removed as per the buyer's representation and suitable new employees must be provided immediately. 2. The agency shall be responsible for providing extra time/or additional personnel for contingent work/ service as and when required. During the various programs/events/dinner functions etc. held freque ntly at the Buyer’s consignee, employees must be allotted for the full day/half day as informed by th e Buyer’s consignee. Under normal circumstances, the departments are closed on public holidays/se cond and fourth Saturdays/Sundays, and those days shall not be counted as working days. In excepti onal circumstances, if an employee is required to attend on a public holiday/second and fourth Satur day/Sunday, those days shall be counted as working days. 3. The agency must hold a Government-recognized registration, and a copy of such document must be enclosed as proof thereof. Also, the person engaging the agency must enclose a xerox copy of a rati on card/PAN card/voter ID card/driving license for his/her identification. 4. The agency must have at least three years of experience of satisfactory outsourcing work for Govern ment / Semi-Government / Co-operative/Public Sector institutions / banks / hospitals / industrial com panies etc. (Supporting evidence for this must be submitted.) 5. The employees of the agency allotted by the agency must behave courteously and must perform the work assigned to them as per the appropriate standards, for which the agency shall be responsible. 6. If a need arises to change any service or time arrangement at the Buyer’s consignee due to require ments, the agency shall be bound to do so. 7. If any injury/accident or death occurs to a service employee engaged during the contract period, the full responsibility shall be that of the agency, and this Buyer’s consignee shall have no responsibility therein. 8. The agency must engage employees who are free from any infectious diseases, healthy and adult, as per Government rules. 9. The agency must engage a sufficient number of employees and must maintain a record of their atten dance and movement. The agency must also comply with the policies and rules of the Buyer’s consig nee. 10. The outsourcing contract shall be under the direct supervision of the Member Secretary, Gujarat Te chnical Education and Research Society (GTERS) and their sister concern respective consignee, and the work/instructions given by them or by an officer/employee authorized by them must be carried out. The agency must submit to the Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research S ociety (GTERS) and their sister concern respective consignee, a list of the employees deployed, with photographs, contact numbers and home addresses. 11. Disputes regarding any matter relating to the agreement shall be settled within Gandhinagar jurisdi ction, and all responsibility regarding all laws/conditions relating to the Labour Commissioner shall b e that of the contractor. Also, if income tax/GST and service tax are required to be deducted as per r ules, that amount shall be deducted directly from the agency's bill by the Accounts Department, and any taxes of any kind, applicable now or in future, shall be borne by the contractor. 12. Employees engaged under the contract cannot demand any fund contribution. Also, if an employee of the agency under the contract is caught committing any kind of irregularity in the Buyer’s consign ee, the full responsibility shall be that of the agency, and if necessary, a police complaint will also be

filed, and the loss will be recovered from the agency's bill. 13. The agency shall be responsible for providing all employees of the agency with the prescribed unifor m determined by the Buyer’s consignee. For the special identification of the agency's employees, th ey must come wearing their uniform and an identity card around the neck whenever they come ever y day to do the assigned work. 14. The agency shall be responsible for compliance with all Government laws relating to the provision o f the agency's employees, and the competent authority/Buyer’s consignee shall not be responsible i n any circumstances for this. The responsibility for paying wages, in accordance with the provisions of the relevant laws and rules, to the employees deployed to provide facility services under the agre ement shall be entirely that of the agency. As per the Minimum Wages Act if applicable, the agency s hall have to revise the rates according to the revisions made from time to time by the Government i n minimum wage rates. 15. The agency must comply with the applicable Labour Contract License and the rules of PF (PF) and ES IC. Copies of the documents relating to the said rules must be made available to the competent offic er of the Buyer’s consignee along with the bill at the time of payment of the bill. 16. There shall be no employer-employee relationship or any other legal liability between the Buyer’s c onsignee and the employees of the agency regarding employment and any matter incidental thereto . If any questions arise from the agency's personnel regarding their service, the Buyer’s consignee s hall have no concern whatsoever in any form. 17. The agency shall be responsible for taking the necessary insurance under a group/personal acciden t policy for the persons deployed by the agency. 18 The agency must get the police verification of the persons deployed by the agency done within 1 mo nth of receiving the outsourcing work contract. 19 The agency is bound to compensate for all loss caused, directly or indirectly, to the property of the B uyer’s consignee, including wires and pipelines, or to any service, Government records, or the belon gings of officers/employees, by the agency's persons due to their incompetence, negligence, or inten tionally or for any other reason, or any loss that the Buyer’s consignee has to bear by the contact aw ardee agency. The agency or its persons shall not remove any material of the Buyer’s consignee wit hout permission. 20 For complaints made by the Buyer’s consignee, the agency must maintain a register of complaints r eceived, in which the action taken must be recorded. A file with proof of complaint redressal must b e maintained. Necessary deductions will be made from the bill for incomplete work. 21 The agency must maintain a daily attendance report containing the details of the persons deployed on that day. The Buyer’s consignee will also separately take attendance. 22 The agency must submit the bill for the work by the fifth of the month following the relevant month. If the work has not been done satisfactorily, payment will be made after deducting a penalty from th e approved monthly rate and deducting taxes as per rules from the payable amount. 23 The ePBG/Security Deposit amount shall be as per GeM and the Gujarat State Procurement Policy 20 24. The Security Deposit amount must be submitted in the form of ePBG/Demand Draft in the name of Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS) upon acceptance o f the contract order. The agency shall give an undertaking for this. The Security Deposit amount will be refunded to the agency one month after the end of the contract period, if the performance is foun d satisfactory and the bills are settled. No interest of any kind shall be payable on the ePBG/Security Deposit amount. 24 This contract is non-transferable. The agency cannot engage a sub-agency. No other matter of this a gency can be transferred to any other agency. 25 The term of the outsourcing contract shall be eleven months from the date of commencement of the contract. Thereafter, if required, subject to satisfactory services by the agency, the outsourcing cont

ract may be extended by a further eleven months by mutual consent at the same annual rate with minimum one week break. Such extended contract agency cannot be transferred to a sub-agency. F or all such intents and purposes, the “Service Provider” shall be the "Employer" within the meaning of different Rules & Acts in respect of manpower so deployed. The persons deployed by the Service Provider shall not have any claim whatsoever like employer and employee relationship against the B uyer. 26 If the agency fails to provide the outsourced man power service satisfactorily and there is no satisfactory improvement in performance despite notice, the agency's security deposit will be forfeit ed and its services will be terminated, for which 15 (fifteen) days' written notice will be given to win d up the man power contract. The Buyer’s consignee shall not be responsible for any expense, loss, or any other difficulty arising from this. 27 Further, notwithstanding any provision in these conditions, the competent authority/Buyer’s consign ee may terminate the agreement by giving the agency 15 (fifteen) days' written notice without assig ning any reason, and no compensation shall be paid for the remaining period of an agreement termi nated in this manner. 28 The agency itself must pay, as per rules, the applicable prevailing taxes including Service Tax and E ducation Cess, SC, PF, ESIC, GST, and bonus. It must also quote its rates taking into account other le gal provisions, including minimum wages (Wage) if applicable, for its employees. Furthermore, the p ayment of the employees engaged must be made by the agency through the bank, and proof thereof must be provided to the Buyer’s consignee every month. 29 In the event of the death of the owner of the agency, the agreement shall be deemed terminated an d his/her legal heirs shall have no right/claim. Nevertheless, if the legal heirs of the owner of the age ncy wish to continue this work at the fixed rates only, as per the terms and conditions of the agreem ent, they may continue this work with the consent of the authority/Buyer’s consignee. 30 Upon selection of the agency for providing outsourcing, the agreement must be executed on stamp paper of prevailing amount as per law, and the expense for this shall be borne by the agency concer ned. The said procedure must be completed within 15 days of the award of contract order. 31 The full authority to accept or not accept any price schedule shall rest with the Member Secretary, G ujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS). 32 Immediately after permission to start work is granted, the man power concerned must be sent to sta rt work in the same uniform as determined by the Buyer’s consignee, and the expense for this shall be borne by the agency concerned. 33 The agency shall be bound to provide the planning or any other details if asked for by the Buyer’s co nsignee to carry out work incidental to this agreement and the work. 34 If the agency's performance is not found satisfactory as per the tender conditions, this Buyer’s consi gnee shall have the unrestricted right to impose a penalty without assigning any reason, and the ag ency will be blacklisted as per GeM rules. 35 After awarding the contract, Bidder/ Service Provider must strictly follow the wages described in the BID after necessary verification of the number of persons required for the daily work and payment of the minimum daily wages to them. In the event that the contract is not awarded to any party, the de cision of the Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Education and Research Society (GTERS) shall be final. 36 Bidder should provide manpower as per the Annexure – F and Consignee will have the power to incr ease and decrease the manpower according to the requirement. 37 Every employee allotted by the agency to the Buyer’s consignee must perform duty as required duri ng the working hours of the Buyer’s consignee. Part-time employees cannot be kept as per requirem ent. Every task shown in Annexure – A must be performed. The attendance sheet of the man power allotted by the agency in the departments of the Buyer’s consignee must be maintained. In case of a

bsence, the Buyer’s consignee will count the total days of absence, calculate the amount at the prev ailing minimum daily wage, and recommend its deduction from the bill, and accordingly the total de duction will be made from the bill of the month concerned. 38 If any work allotted to the manpower is not completed within the stipulated time limit, then that wor k will be allocated by the buyer/ consignee to external agency without tendering process. The cost o f such work will be deducted from the amount of the agency's monthly bill. No dispute or argument r egarding this will be accepted. 39 All necessary documents, bills or details to be submitted with the bill, such as the amount payable t o the employees, the PF deduction of the agency's employees, a copy of the bank statement of the s alaries paid, etc., must be submitted on time to time to each Buyer’s consignee. 40 During office hours, the agency must provide the necessary workers/manpower at its own cost when ever a need arises for contingent additional work in any consignee department within the bid conditi on. Any other additional manpower requirement more than in bid condition will be paid extra for tim e being when it is asked in written. If requirement arised is less than bid condition then paid less acc ordingly for that time period only. 41 The agency must create its own E-mail and check it regularly, redress the complaints received, infor m the concerned department officer of the redressal, maintain a record/register, and show it whene ver the officer in charge asks for it. 42 From the time the work order is given to the agency, the work must be carried out as per the bid con ditions, in the existing condition of the premises. 43 Under normal circumstances, the Buyer’s consignee will be closed on every second and fourth Satur day, Sunday or public holiday, but if any function/program/event is organized on those days, the em ployees of the agency must be present if so, informed by the department concerned. 44 The employees allotted by the outsourcing agency must perform their duties in compliance with the instructions given by the Government from time to time, taking into account epidemics and emerge ncy situations. 45 One branch of the agency's office must necessarily be registered in Gujarat and must submit the nec essary documents as proof, such as the municipal tax receipt of the office, the applicable rent agree ment and the electricity bill; otherwise, the bidder will be disqualified. 46 In any matter relating to this contract, the decision of the Member Secretary, Gujarat Technical Educ ation and Research Society (GTERS) shall be considered final and must be accepted. 47 The outsourcing agency must submit a certificate stating that it has not previously been blacklisted by any Government institution or PSU, in the form of a copy certified by a notary after the date on w hich the bid was announced. 48 Along with the bill of every month, documentary proof of the payment of the minimum wages, ESIC, bonus, PF, etc. paid for the previous month must be provided; otherwise, the bill will not be paid. 49 Employees must be provided as per the number of employees and required qualifications shown in Annexure – A. 50 Submission of false or incorrect information, reports of unprofessional conduct, amongst other thing s, shall lead to disqualification of the bidder. 51 Bidders shall submit offers that comply with the requirements of the tender. Alternatives will not be considered unless specifically called for by the authority. 52 The manpower will be entitled to 01 leave per month which will be carry forwarded to next month if unused. Beyond specified leaves as applicable, leave will be treated as leave without pay (LWP) 53 The service provider/contractor shall be responsible for paying proportionate gratuity to contract lab our who have rendered continuous service as per the provisions of the Payment of Gratuity Act, 197 2.

54 The manpower provided by the Service Provider shall not be deemed employees of the Buyer depart ment hence the compliance of the applicable acts/ laws will be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. 55 The Service Provider shall furnish the following documents in respect of the manpower deployed by them to Buyer's premise/ designated premise in the given time limit: i. List of persons deployed (monthly) ii. CV/Resume with Required details (at the time of deployment) iii. Copy of Aadhaar Card of the candidates (at the time of deployment) iv. Identity Cards issued by Service Provider bearing photograph (within 8 days of joi ning) v. Identity proof and residential proof (at the time of deployment) vi. Copy of police verification certificate (at the time of deployment) vii. Copy of birth certificate, if required (at the time of deployment - for domicile purp ose) viii. Details of PF Account Number of resources. 56 The Service Provider shall nominate a coordinator/ Single Point of Contact (SPOC) who shall be resp onsible for regular interaction with the Buyer Department so that optimal services of the persons dep loyed could be availed without any disruption. 57 In an event of deployed manpower availing leave, and if required by Buyer, suitable substitute(s) sh all be provided by Service Provider as per mutual understanding with Buyer. Service Provider shall c ommunicate the same to buyer in advance. 58. In case of any resource permanently leaving the agency or taking leave for a longer duration, servic e provider shall communicate the same to buyer at least 1 month prior to the last working day of a r esources. Suitable substitute(s) shall be provided by Service Provider as per mutual understanding with buyer. 59. No medical facilities or reimbursement or any sort of medical claims thereof in respect of employee s provided by the Service Provider will be entertained by the Buyer. 60. For all intents and purposes, the “Service Provider” shall be the "Employer" within the meaning of di fferent Rules & Acts in respect of manpower so deployed. The persons deployed by the Service Provi der shall not have any claim whatsoever like employer and employee relationship against the Buyer. 61. No deployed manpower shall be allowed to stay in the Buyer's premise/ designated premise unnece ssarily after working hours without Buyer's permission. 62. The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for the redressal of grievances/ resolution of disput es relating to persons deployed. The Buyer shall, in no way be responsible for settlement of such iss ues whatsoever. 63. The Service Provider shall ensure regular payment to the deployed manpower to their entitlements like monthly salaries/ wages etc. and submit the documentary proof of the salary paid as per the ter ms and conditions of the contract. Bill for the subsequent month will be paid only after submission of certificate of disbursement of wages of previous month. 64. The Service Provider shall submit before the Buyer Department, one copy of the return within 7 day s from the date of filing of monthly/ quarterly/ half yearly/ annual return if any before the EPF and ES I authorities. 65. All applicable taxes and duties other than mentioned in the contract document, shall be payable by the Service Provider and the Buyer shall not entertain any claims whatsoever with respect to the sa me.

66. The Service Provider, at all times, will ensure that the services being provided under this Contract/A greement are performed strictly in accordance with all applicable laws, order, byelaws, regulations, notifications, guidelines, rules, standards, recommended practices etc. and no liability in this regard will be attached to the Buyer. 67.
